title: Training Modality
description: A category of physical quality. Goal profiles weight these; the scheduler uses recovery cost and compatibility rules to place sessions. One file per modality.

id.description: Unique slug matching the enum used in other schemas. e.g. 'aerobic_base', 'max_strength'

description.description: One-sentence definition. e.g. 'Zone 1-2 steady-state work building the aerobic engine.'

recovery_cost.description: How demanding this modality is on recovery. Governs minimum rest before repeating. low = can stack on adjacent days; medium = 24h; high = 48h minimum.

recovery_hours_min.description: Minimum hours before this modality can be repeated; between two high-cost modalities the larger of their two, and never under 48 (scheduler.recovery_window, which fidelity audits by).

priority_tier.description: Which modality the scheduler keeps when days are scarce: 1 is kept first, 4 dropped first (3 without one). Read by src/loader.py; it used to be a table in code.

typical_duration_minutes.description: The session length the scheduler matches to the athlete's long and short days (60 without one).

fallback_rank.description: Present on the modalities that stand in for a session no archetype serves, in this order (generator._resolve_session). A framework's fallback_modalities overrides the order.

display.description: How the clients draw the modality. tools/gen_client_vocab.py writes the web's and the Apple apps' tables from it.

label.description: The short name every screen shows.

short.description: The word a watch complication has room for ("Zone 2").

order.description: Where the modality is listed among the others (the builder's priority bars, the authoring dialogs).

color.description: The one colour every client draws it in.

tint.description: The Tailwind colour family of the web's tint classes (bg-<tint>-500/15 …).

text_shade.description: The web's light-mode text shade on its /15 tint (WCAG AA at text-xs).

ios.description: An SF Symbol for the phone and its widgets.

watch.description: An SF Symbol for the Apple Watch.

session_position.description: Where this modality's session goes in a day it shares: first, last, either (any), or standalone (never combined into another session). The scheduler orders a day's sessions by it (scheduler._order_day).

compatible_in_session_with.description: Modality IDs that can share a session with this one. Order matters — list higher-priority pairings first.

incompatible_in_session_with.description: Modality IDs that must not share a session with this one.

min_weekly_minutes.description: Minimum effective weekly volume in minutes. Below this, adaptation does not occur.

max_weekly_minutes.description: Maximum recoverable weekly volume in minutes. Above this, performance degrades.

typical_session_minutes.description: Typical session length range in minutes.

progression_model.description: ID of the primary progression model that governs advancement in this modality.

intensity_zones.description: Intensity levels meaningful for this modality. Not all modalities use heart-rate zones.
